name: JW Marriott Hotel Marina
positioning: Waterfront hotel in the heart of Dubai Marina with direct access to Dubai Marina Mall, a rooftop infinity pool over the marina, and rooms and suites with marina or city skyline views
best_for: Travelers who want to be steps from JBR beach and Dubai Marina Walk with direct access to Dubai Marina Mall
Families looking for a Kids Club and a pool with marina views

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Dubai Marina and has direct access to Dubai Marina Mall.
The hotel is steps away from JBR beach and close to Ain Dubai, Blue Waters Island and Dubai Marina Walk.
The Marina Executive Room has views of Dubai Marina and a private balcony.
The Presidential Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows framing the Marina skyline.
The spa, SuperiorMed Longevity Clinic & Spa, offers holistic treatments, massages and clinic services.
The 24-hour gym has views of the Marina.
The ground-floor Executive Lounge has indoor and outdoor seating.
The Executive Lounge serves complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails.
Family by JW includes a dedicated Kids Club and in-room amenities for children.
JW Kitchen has waterfront Marina views and serves global cuisines with live cooking stations.
Griffin Lobby Lounge serves afternoon tea, artisan coffee, fine teas and handcrafted pastries.
Self parking and valet parking are complimentary for guests.

highlights.text: The infinity pool has panoramic views of Dubai Marina.
The outdoor pool is on the rooftop.
Each suite has floor-to-ceiling windows looking out on the marina or the city skyline.
The JW Garden is an indoor garden that grows fresh herbs such as mint and parsley for the hotel's kitchens.

considerations.text: The closest airport is Al Maktoum International Airport, about 35 kilometers from the hotel.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the busy marina area can be crowded during peak times.
